baselineAnd30_60_90DayTargets.methodologyNote: Record a clean 14-day baseline in Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools, GA4, and GBP immediately after sitemap submission. The 30/60/90-day figures below are operational measurement targets benchmarked against the 2-week baseline (not guaranteed ranking promises).

kpis.twoWeekBaselineProtocol: Record valid indexed URLs out of 99 canonical sitemap URLs after Day 14
kpis.day30Target: 80 - 90 indexed canonical pages (100% of 32 SKUs + 6 category hubs + top pillars)
kpis.day60Target: 92 - 99 indexed canonical pages (all 32 SKUs, 28 blogs, 18 recipes, 11 city hubs)
kpis.day90Target: 99/99 canonical URLs indexed with 0 duplicate/redirect/404 coverage errors

kpis.twoWeekBaselineProtocol: Multiply 14-day post-indexation impressions by 2x for 28-day baseline (B_imp)
kpis.day30Target: 1.5x - 2.0x over 2-week baseline pace as all 32 Product & 6 Category schemas enter SERPs
kpis.day60Target: 3.0x - 4.0x over baseline pace driven by baby weaning, powder, and dry-fruit comparison clusters
kpis.day90Target: 5.0x - 7.0x over baseline pace across English + Roman Nepali + Devanagari queries

kpis.metric: Search Console Organic Clicks (28-Day Rolling, Nepal)
kpis.day30Target: 1.5x over baseline pace with >= 3.5% average CTR from NPR price & stock rich snippets
kpis.day60Target: 2.5x - 3.5x over baseline pace with >= 4.2% average CTR across product & recipe pages
kpis.day90Target: 4.5x - 6.0x over baseline pace with >= 4.8% average CTR

kpis.metric: Tracked Queries in Top-3 / Top-10 (out of 60 Nepal Mobile Queries)
kpis.twoWeekBaselineProtocol: Log initial positions for all 60 queries in weekly-rank-tracker-60-queries.csv on Day 1 & Day 14
kpis.day30Target: 5 - 8 queries in Top-3 (brand + rare SKUs: Avocado, Strawberry, Sweet Potato, Dates Powder) | 18+ in Top-10
kpis.day60Target: 12 - 18 queries in Top-3 (baby weaning cluster + core powders & dehydrated fruits) | 32+ in Top-10
kpis.day90Target: 22 - 30 queries in Top-3 across product, category & baby/gift/fitness buckets | 45+ in Top-10

kpis.metric: Monthly Organic Website + WhatsApp-Assisted Orders (GA4 purchase + whatsapp_click)
kpis.twoWeekBaselineProtocol: Record 14-day organic checkout purchases + organic product-page WhatsApp order clicks
kpis.day60Target: +60% to +90% lift over baseline run-rate (assisted by blog/recipe -> product internal funnels)

kpis.metric: Verified Order-Tied Customer Reviews Collected (with Photo & City Tag)
kpis.twoWeekBaselineProtocol: Count verified reviews via /track-order WhatsApp review flow during first 14 days
kpis.day30Target: 15 - 25 new verified order-tied reviews across top 10 bestseller SKUs
kpis.day60Target: 40 - 60 cumulative verified reviews covering at least 20 of 32 canonical SKUs
kpis.day90Target: 80 - 110+ cumulative verified reviews covering all 32 SKUs (unlocking organic AggregateRating on every SKU)

kpis.metric: Google Business Profile (GBP) Monthly Actions (Calls, Website Clicks, Direction/Delivery Inquiries)
kpis.twoWeekBaselineProtocol: Record 14-day GBP Insights interactions after uploading the 32 GBP products from gbp-optimization-pack.json
kpis.day30Target: 32/32 GBP products live + 4 weekly posts published -> +30% GBP website & WhatsApp/call actions
kpis.day60Target: 8 weekly posts + 10 seeded Q&As + 20 GBP photo reviews -> +75% GBP actions
kpis.day90Target: 12 weekly posts + 40+ GBP reviews -> +150% GBP actions & Page-1 Local Pack presence in Kathmandu Valley

kpis.metric: AI Answer Engine Citation & Price/Weight Accuracy (25 Prompts across 4 AI Engines)
kpis.twoWeekBaselineProtocol: Run all 25 prompts in ai-citation-tracker-25-prompts.csv on Day 14 to record initial citation rate
kpis.day30Target: 100% price/weight accuracy whenever NaturesMud is cited (0 stale Rs. 599/499 powder hallucinations); cited on >= 8/25 prompts
kpis.day60Target: Cited with accurate NPR price & weight on >= 14/25 buying & how-to prompts
kpis.day90Target: Cited with accurate NPR price, weight & canonical URL on >= 19/25 prompts across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini & Google AI Mode
